en.title: E
en.summary: The letter name is E, as in the word Elefant.

sections.title: The letter E
paragraphs: The letter name is (E) /eː/. Its main sound is heard in the word (Elefant) /eleˈfant/, which means elephant. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter makes four sounds in German.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, smile slightly and raise your tongue high and forward. For the second sound, drop your jaw slightly lower and keep your tongue front. For the third sound, relax your tongue and lips completely in the centre of your mouth. For the fourth sound, open your mouth a bit wider with a relaxed tongue. Put your hand on your throat to feel your voice buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In long, stressed syllables or spelled double, say /eː/ as in (Tee) /teː/. In short, stressed syllables followed by multiple consonants, say /ɛ/ as in (Bett) /bɛt/. In unstressed prefixes or word endings, say the schwa sound as in (bitte) /ˈbɪtə/. In unstressed endings with the letter r, say /ɐ/ as in (Mutter) /ˈmʊtɐ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the long vowel into a glide like the sound in day. Keep your tongue steady and do not move your lips at the end. Do not pronounce the final unstressed vowel like the sound in see. Keep the ending very short and relaxed, like the first vowel in about.
